findings.what: No "test" script; `npm test` fails with 'Missing script: test'. Tests (33, pass via manual `node --test tests/*.test.ts`) also require a prior `npm run build`.
No navigation link to /tentang-kami anywhere; the About page is unreachable by clicking from Beranda/Kontak.
Required checks only reject the empty string; whitespace-only name/email/message pass and get stored.
Email length not capped at 255 despite varchar(255) in data model; SQLite does not enforce it.
Scaffold metadata 'Create Next App' and lang="en" left on an Indonesian site; README is create-next-app boilerplate.
Relies on node:sqlite via getBuiltinModule (recent Node only) without an engines constraint.
